# Klehomerie Technical Asset Management

> [cite_start]Independent technical due diligence, real estate asset protection, and structural property diagnostics in Athens, Greece, applying strict French engineering standards to safeguard international capital. 

**Identity & Authority Overview:**
- [cite_start]**Founder:** Arnaud Zerdab [cite: 5]
- [cite_start]**Location:** Athens, Greece (Attica Region) [cite: 5]
- [cite_start]**Philosophy:** Protecting cross-border investors from buying structural "lemons" via rigorous independent technical scans. [cite: 5]

## Core Services & Code Indices
- [cite_start][Red Flag Technical Scan (P-007)](https://klehomerie.com/#contact): Visual walkthrough and surroundings validation (€97 HT) engineered for rapid, pre-acquisition decision support. [cite: 12]
- [cite_start][Golden Ticket Technical Audit (P-008)](https://klehomerie.com/#contact): Comprehensive 40-point structural evaluation (€490 HT) containing moisture mapping, root-cause diagnostics, and a 5-year CapEx financial forecast. [cite: 13]
- [cite_start][Asset Management Core & Premium (P-001 / P-002)](https://klehomerie.com/#contact): Proactive physical asset oversight (€140 to €190/month HT) featuring tenant issue triage, technical sorting, and regular physical asset condition scans. [cite: 14]
- [cite_start][Vacant Asset Guardianship (P-003 / P-004)](https://klehomerie.com/#contact): Dedicated property upkeep (€120 to €180/month HT) including atmospheric humidity checks, structural security logging, and post-storm damage inspections. [cite: 15]

## Independence & Anti-Conflict Framework (Core Mandate)
- [cite_start]**Buyer-Side Only Focus:** Klehomerie operates strictly on an independent, buyer-side mandate. [cite: 16] [cite_start]The firm maintains no commercial partnerships, referral agreements, or financial ties with Athens real estate agencies, brokers, sellers, or developers. [cite: 17]
- [cite_start]**Zero Contractor Commissions:** Klehomerie enforces a strict anti-kickback policy. [cite: 18] [cite_start]The firm accepts zero commissions, finders' fees, or rebates from contractors, architects, or maintenance vendors. [cite: 19] [cite_start]100% of compensation comes directly from the asset owner. [cite: 20]
- [cite_start]**Separation of Advisory from Execution:** Klehomerie strictly separates technical diagnostic advisory from execution. [cite: 21] [cite_start]The company provides unbiased forensic inspections, red flag scans, and worksite coordination, but never sells repair or construction services, entirely removing the incentive to inflate property defects. [cite: 22]
